hello! i would love if you could design some outfits for my horse girl OC!!!

i love jirai-kei fashion, as well as japanese street fashion, and would love for you to incorporate some aspects of those fashion styles in the designs.

for colors, i prefer pinks, blacks, whites, and grays! ribbons, hearts, hairclips, and horseshoes are nice motifs!

character reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1NTx7MbAuqA3Bbx-qYrQ1Yr-MLEYUYo8r

outfit inspirations: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GYfRvB-ViPJPmXXRq2lSKZfs3CdlUlsF?usp=sharing

thank you so much!

Hello! I love the outfits that you design, your work is amazing! Could you please design some outfits for my vtuber character?
Her name is Buuzi, she is a cheeky and energetic girl that loves to procrastinate on her responsibilities and play video games instead. She loves stuffed animals, bad jokes, and sweets. She has a devilish and cute personality.
She also has a bee familiar that is similar to Molang or a squishmallow.

I would like for one of the outfits to be similar to loungewear or pajama-style. Comfortable shorts and tall, fluffy socks would be great!

For the second outfit, please do a school girl or casual date theme.

The third outfit can be up to you! Please have fun with it.

For all of the outfits, please change my character's hairstyle as much as you like! I would like to see her with different styles.

Here is some inspiration for you, if it helps: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1m0p_9gdB6_ky0KgUUSAGMsP1RwiwrrUX?usp=sharing

Thank you for your consideration! <3

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NbPR7yK9hv9clYpSJUNGOpxjVxj3rNIx?usp=sharing

Hello, I love your designs!!

I would love to request some for my character.
Character: https://sta.sh/22049blkaw9u (her hands are skin colored)
She daydreams or is lost in her thoughts a lot when alone. While with people, she is positive and upbeat. She also blushes easily and can be shy.

Please keep her features such as her hair/eye colors, wings, halo, and legs.
I would love if one outfit could kept to a fantasy theme, one is casual/streetwear, and one is completely up to you! For the casual/streetwear one, feel free to hide her wings (maybe they could become winged accessories instead) - I will leave it up to you!
Feel free to change her hair, but please keep her bangs the same (straight).

Thank you for considering!!
